description: WebSocket upgrade behind proxies: the /ws router now waits for the full request line (proxies may split upgrade headers across TCP segments, and a partial first peek misrouted /ws to the HTTP handler so wss never completed), plus a 426 Upgrade-Required safety net if /ws ever reaches plain HTTP instead of silently serving the SPA shell.
features: WS peek waits for the full request line before routing, so split upgrade headers behind the funnel still reach the WS hub.
426 Upgrade Required safety net for /ws landing on plain HTTP (replaces the silent SPA-shell 200 that failed upgrades without a diagnostic).
Version synced to 0.17.3 in server APP_VERSION, pyproject.toml and updates.json.
